declared: 2026-11-08, before the frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle of these exact bytes. The shapes copy core's `cold_path`, `likely` and `unlikely` declarations, whose `cold_path()` call ended census 8's second diagnostic. Each outcome follows the stated rule (an intrinsic call in a recursively const-checked body is exposed when the intrinsic is marked const-stable-indirect, or when it has a fallback body that is itself safe to expose; a bodiless or explicitly const-unstable one is not), not this compiler's probe

cold-hint-length.rs.reason: core's unmarked `cold_path` fallback intrinsic is implicitly const-stable-indirect, so core's recursively checked `unlikely` may call it; a length reaches it

cold-hint-body.rs.reason: the same `likely` and `unlikely` bodies with only a runtime caller

marked-bodiless-hint.rs.reason: a bodiless `assume` marked `rustc_intrinsic_const_stable_indirect` is exposed from an unmarked const fn

bodiless-assume-exposed.rs.reason: opponent: an unmarked bodiless `assume` has no fallback to expose, so a recursively checked const fn cannot call it

const-unstable-cold-hint.rs.reason: opponent: an explicit `rustc_const_unstable` `cold_path` is not const-stable-indirect, so its fallback is not exposed to the recursively checked `unlikely`
